📰 The Browser Company Retires Its Arc Browser, Pushes Users to Dia

The Browser Company is shutting down its Arc browser on December 22 and encouraging users to migrate to Dia, its newer AI-powered browser for Apple Silicon Macs and Windows 11 PCs. Thurrott reports...
